es-419.current: La señal mostrada prohíbe el paso a todos los vehículos de motor
es-419.proposed: La señal mostrada prohíbe el paso a todos los vehículos de la categoría italiana autoveicoli, como automóviles, autobuses y camiones

evidence.support: Art. 54(1) defines autoveicoli as motor vehicles of at least four wheels, excluding motoveicoli; its classes include cars, buses and trucks.
Art. 53 classifies motoveicoli separately, including two-wheeled motorcycles, three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles.
Art. 52 defines ciclomotori as motor vehicles; hence a general term for all motor vehicles also includes vehicles outside autoveicoli.
DPR 495/1992 art. 117(1)(g): sign II.58 prohibits all autoveicoli, including three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles.

rows.reason: The original legal category is retained and illustrated with non-exhaustive representative classes from Article 54(1), without asserting that other categories may pass. The quantifier and stated prohibition or its alleged end are preserved.
rows.ambiguity: Autoveicoli has no exact everyday equivalent in these languages. The examples make the class more intelligible but do not fully define its boundary; the independently reviewed explanation must clarify classification and, separately, sign II.58’s additional coverage of three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles. The source text is a statement about all autoveicoli, not a statement that the sign applies only to them.

review.assessment: The translations identify the exact Italian legal category and make it intelligible with examples rather than claiming an exhaustive definition. Each preserves all and the proposition; neither adds a claim that other classes may pass. Examples do not define marginal cases, so independently reviewed teaching material should explain the classification and the separate sign coverage.
